provenance.paper_title: ReflectWorld-MM: An Entity-Oriented Multi-Media Memory System for Open-Ended Video Streams

evidence.paraphrase: A bounded front end creates entity-resolved observations.

representation_paths.memory_component: episodic, semantic and procedural entity memory

evidence.paraphrase: Long-term memory couples multi-scale episodes with evolving entity semantics and procedures.
A fixed hierarchy consolidates observations. For ReflectWorld-MM, this specifically supports episodic or hierarchical summarization of entity-resolved multimedia observations.

Repeated experience becomes semantic and procedural memory. For ReflectWorld-MM, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of entity-resolved multimedia observations.
Later observations revise conflicting entity knowledge. For ReflectWorld-MM, this specifically supports LLM-based resolution of conflicting records of entity-resolved multimedia observations.

evidence.section: Full paper: Retrieval and System Realization
evidence.paraphrase: A fixed GPT-based manager chooses Add, Update, Delete, or no-change actions after accumulating observations. For ReflectWorld-MM, this specifically supports LLM-mediated memory editing of entity-resolved multimedia observations.

evidence.section: Full paper: Retrieval and System Realization
evidence.paraphrase: Repeated confirmation increases an entity memory's importance through a fixed evidence-reweighting rule. For ReflectWorld-MM, this specifically supports evidence-weighted revision of stored belief or confidence of entity-resolved multimedia observations.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (entity-resolved multimedia observations) changes through episodic or hierarchical summarization, abstraction of episodes into reusable experience, LLM-based resolution of conflicting records, LLM-mediated memory editing, evidence-weighted revision of stored belief or confidence; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
